title: candidate/v1
description: targets/<id>/review/candidates/<id>.yaml beside <id>.lean (F26-R1, R3; D-9 v3.39): one Lean formalization of the review's conjecture — a person's or a model's — with its author, the models that helped or none, and the author's declaration of having read another candidate's Lean, shown as a claim. Its stage-3 result lives in the exhibits the gate writes, never here. Append-only; never deleted, a discarded candidate stays on the record with its reason. Versioned, never edited (D-34).

target.description: the target the record is filed under

author.description: the ledger identity (pseudonym) credited as the candidate's author; for a ported statement the registry's authors joined by `; `

method.description: D-23 v3.37's vocabulary: `manual` is a person's candidate (and `models` is empty), the others a model's part

models.description: the models that helped, each named (v3.31); empty for a person's candidate

read_others.description: the author's declaration of having read another candidate's Lean before writing this one; null where the author made none; a claim the network shows and does not verify (F26-R3)

origin.description: `submitted` through the service; `ported`, a registry's or the live statement entered as the first candidate; `wrapper`, the review's own wrapper naming a ported statement's parts, proved equal to it (F26-R5)

ref.description: the registry entry, the node id, or the candidate a wrapper wraps

source.description: what a ported candidate or a wrapper came from; null for a submitted one

lean_file.description: the candidate's Lean beside this record

statement_hash.description: sha256 of the Lean file's bytes

id.description: the record's id, lowercase alphanumerics and hyphens; a candidate's is `c-<8 hex>` of its Lean's sha256, a test's `t-<8 hex>`, a question's `q-<n>`, an exhibit's `e-<8 hex>`
